assets.name: streaming-library-poster-atlas
assets.prompt: Create a production-ready square image atlas for a fictional premium streaming-library SwiftUI demo. Exact layout: 5 columns by 3 rows, exactly 15 equal rectangular poster cells, perfectly aligned edge-to-edge with no gutters, no borders, no labels. Every cell must be an entirely different cinematic fictional movie key art scene and color story: mountain mystery at amber dusk; rain-soaked neon detective city; deep-ocean diver; orbital spacecraft drama; intimate kitchen romance; desert expedition; arctic research thriller; jazz-club period drama; forest folklore; courtroom political thriller; coastal family drama; futuristic train journey; volcanic survival story; moonlit dance film; botanical science mystery. Premium editorial film-poster photography, visually rich, clean focal subjects, strong silhouettes and lighting, each cell composition survives a portrait crop. No UI, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no recognizable actors, brands, franchises, costumes, or copyrighted characters. The grid geometry must be exact and consistent so software can crop each of the 15 cells independently.
assets.reviewNote: Original 15-tile fictional poster atlas; all visible scenes are distinct and no readable text, logo, trademark, signature, or watermark was observed.
